headline: Join us and Seize the Night
kicker: Three Night Races in Maricopa County
intro: Join us this summer as we ride into the night and glimpse our world nocturnal. Aravaipa Rides kicks off our night series with three rides to get you howling at the moon! This ride series will challenge us all to push beyond the shadows of doubt and wonder in order to illuminate a world of possibility.
It's our way of escaping the summer heat while continuing to race and experience both familiar and unfamiliar trails in a different light. Distances range from 7 miles to 6-hours.
What will you discover in the night? How far will the stars guide your path? Imagine how far your summer will take you!

a: Back by popular demand, our fantastic Insomniac Series Passes are here to save you some money (20-25%!) and explore more of the great trails around the valley, all at night!
In addition to the current race perks, there will be a unique Insomniac finisher award for anyone completing all THREE of the summer Insomniac Night Trail Ride Series!
When registering for the Insomniac Night Trail Ride Pass options, there is no refund for missing one or more races in the series, whether notified before or after the event.

We will take the top 10 male and female finishers of the 6-hour, 3-hour and single lap short course in each race and award points. The racer with the most points at the end of the series is the winner. You must race all three separate events to qualify for the series podium.

Points are not shared between categories, so points scored in the 6-hour do not apply to the 3-hour, and vice versa. In the case of a tie, the tie breaker will be determined by the racers total number of 1st place finishes, then 2nd place, then 3rd and onward if necessary.
